_note: Contacts (diplomacy::contacts). Drafted 2026-10-22 from the Capitals and Story Quests Plan's dialogue tab; edit the lines freely. role: Hub | Military | Trade | Underworld | Outpost. story: holds a step of the Summit Record chain (never lost when a capital falls).

contacts.name: The Abbess
contacts.greeting: You are very loud. Not your engines. You.
contacts.offer: There is a record of a meeting. Every faction keeps a piece of it. Bring me the pieces, and I will tell you what you are hearing.
contacts.trusted: I counted the voices in you, once. I stopped at a billion. I am sorry.

contacts.name: Brother Lull
contacts.greeting: ... (he hands you a price list)
contacts.offer: Carry this to our sister house. Do not open it. There is nothing in it.
contacts.trusted: We kept you a berth. We kept it quiet.

contacts.name: Sister Stillwater
contacts.greeting: We do not fight. Others fight near us.
contacts.offer: Something is shooting at our pilgrims. Make it stop. We will not ask how.
contacts.trusted: You are the only violence we have ever been grateful for.

contacts.name: The Listener
contacts.greeting: Welcome. Speak softly.
contacts.offer: There is a pilgrim ship missing. Find it, if you can bear to listen to what is left.
contacts.trusted: Come back when it is too loud inside you. It is quiet here.

contacts.name: Broker Anselm Quay
contacts.greeting: A new customer. Or an old one, in a new hull? I lose track.
contacts.offer: I have something the Silence wants and the Compact wants more. Help me decide who wants it most.
contacts.trusted: I have sold the end of the world four times. Yours is the first I would like to keep.

contacts.name: Contracts Officer Delphine Mott
contacts.greeting: The Guild does not fight. The Guild pays people who do.
contacts.offer: A Compact tanker is undercutting us on fuel. Discourage it.
contacts.trusted: I wrote your name into three contracts. It is a compliment. Mostly.

contacts.name: The Auctioneer
contacts.greeting: Lot forty-seven. Bidding starts with your attention.
contacts.offer: A buyer wants a Throne shield emitter. The Throne does not want to sell. Bridge the gap.
contacts.trusted: I would auction you, if you ever came up. I would bid on you myself.

contacts.name: Factor Ilse Brandt
contacts.greeting: Prices are posted. Discounts are personal.
contacts.offer: Our pedlar is overdue. Find her, or find who has her cargo.
contacts.trusted: For you, the personal price.

contacts.name: Dispatcher Maren Holt
contacts.greeting: You hauling or you blocking the lane?
contacts.offer: We pulled a black box out of a dead station. The Princes want it buried. Get it, and us, home.
contacts.trusted: Union card's yours if you want it. Nobody's ever wanted it. Means something.

contacts.name: Shop Steward Teo Varga
contacts.greeting: Every one of my crews shoots back. Every one.
contacts.offer: Ore run through Princes space. Ride along and make sure it stays an ore run.
contacts.trusted: You covered us. We remember who covers us.

contacts.name: Pike
contacts.greeting: Salvage diver. Don't ask what I dive.
contacts.offer: There's a wreck in the deep nobody's claimed, because nobody comes back. I'll split it.
contacts.trusted: I found your ship's name on a hull plate once. Older than you. Didn't want to tell you.

contacts.name: Yardmaster Ruth Okafor
contacts.greeting: Fuel's cheap. Patience isn't.
contacts.offer: Tug's dead in the water two systems over. Bring her in.
contacts.trusted: Pay's late. Your berth isn't.

contacts.name: Rex, aged nineteen
contacts.greeting: I'm in charge today. Don't tell me.
contacts.offer: The old me is hoarding hulls. Steal three. I'll know which.
contacts.trusted: You're the only one I've met who isn't me. It's nice.

contacts.name: Rex, aged forty-six
contacts.greeting: Ignore the young one. Ignore the old one. Ignore me, actually.
contacts.offer: I need a part only the Compact makes. They won't sell to me. Any of me.
contacts.trusted: Between us: the original is still alive. I hate him.

contacts.name: Rex, aged eighty
contacts.greeting: I remember being you. No. Being them. Never mind.
contacts.offer: A copy of me went missing in the deep. Bring him back, or bring back what he saw.
contacts.trusted: I am the oldest. I was here first. I am not the first.

contacts.name: Rex, aged eight
contacts.greeting: Are you a person or a copy?
contacts.offer: My big self lost a ship. Can you find it?
contacts.trusted: I think you might be a lot of people too.

contacts.name: The Cantor
contacts.greeting: We heard you coming. We hear everything coming. Sit.
contacts.offer: There is one frequency in us we cannot bear to play. Hold our border, and we will play it for you.
contacts.trusted: It was your voice. We kept it safe. We did not know whose it was until you came in.

contacts.name: Chorister Seven
contacts.greeting: Seven. There were eleven. Do not ask.
contacts.offer: The Collective is singing on our border. Silence them.
contacts.trusted: You do not flinch when we talk all at once. The others flinch.

contacts.name: The Antiphon
contacts.greeting: Buy. Buy. Sell. No. Buy.
contacts.offer: Bring us anything that still hums. We pay for hums.
contacts.trusted: We would sing for you, but you would hear yourself.

contacts.name: Verger Hollis
contacts.greeting: Mind the echo.
contacts.offer: A ghost ship of ours is broadcasting. Find out what it is saying.
contacts.trusted: It was saying your name. I thought you should know.

contacts.name: Warden Hesper Lune
contacts.greeting: Careful. Everything here is alive, and some of it is listening.
contacts.offer: I have a specimen that grows faster when it is near other minds. Carry it through the Collective's space. Do not stop.
contacts.trusted: I know what it eats now. I am frightened of you, a little. Come anyway.

contacts.name: Ranger Coll Ashby
contacts.greeting: Engines off near the herds.
contacts.offer: Pirates are culling our herd-ships. Cull them.
contacts.trusted: The herds know your hull. They don't scatter any more.

contacts.name: The Pruner
contacts.greeting: Some branches must go. I decide which.
contacts.offer: A keeper has gone rogue with a specimen. Bring both back. Or one.
contacts.trusted: I have never had to prune you. I hope I never do.

contacts.name: Keeper Mira Sole
contacts.greeting: Wipe your boots. Metaphorically.
contacts.offer: A seed ark lost its tow. Help it home.
contacts.trusted: Something in the ark followed you around the hold. It liked you.

contacts.name: Graft-Speaker Ilun
contacts.greeting: We see you. All of you. There is more of you than there should be.
contacts.offer: The Preserve is carrying something we want to understand. Bring it to us instead.
contacts.trusted: Join us. No. We know. You already did, a long time ago, somewhere else.

contacts.name: Node-Captain Vey
contacts.greeting: We are many hulls and one intention.
contacts.offer: A Choir chorus is drowning out our network. End the song.
contacts.trusted: We have grown a place for you in the network. It is warm.

contacts.name: The Splice
contacts.greeting: The screaming in the network is just data corruption.
contacts.offer: A part of us broke off and is running. Bring it back. Gently, if you can.
contacts.trusted: It was not data corruption. You knew that.

contacts.name: Tender Ossa
contacts.greeting: We are pleased. We are always pleased.
contacts.offer: Bring us flesh-and-metal salvage. Fresh.
contacts.trusted: We would like to keep a sample of you. Just a small one.

contacts.name: Repossessor Calloway Merrit
contacts.greeting: Your consciousness credit score is... concerning.
contacts.offer: A summit delegate defaulted on her own mind. We hold it as collateral. Buy the debt out, or try your luck with the vault.
contacts.trusted: I have revised your rating upward. Do not let it go to your heads. Head.

contacts.name: Under-Treasurer Seraphine Ashgrove
contacts.greeting: Everything has a price. The price is my department.
contacts.offer: Bullion moves at the hour. Make sure it arrives at the hour.
contacts.trusted: You've become an asset. Assets are protected. Congratulations.

contacts.name: The Liquidator
contacts.greeting: I buy what the Board pretends it never sold.
contacts.offer: A Hegemony railgun battery would look lovely in our vault. Acquire one.
contacts.trusted: When the Board liquidates you, I'll make sure I get a share.

contacts.name: Concierge Abernathy
contacts.greeting: Welcome, valued client. Your tier has been noted.
contacts.offer: A shareholder's yacht is overdue. Retrieve it, and discreetly.
contacts.trusted: Platinum tier. We've never had a ship at platinum tier.

contacts.name: Prelate Morrow-Who-Is-Fading
contacts.greeting: Everything ends. You are early.
contacts.offer: There is a cache from the universe before. It speaks. Bring us what it says.
contacts.trusted: We have seen this before. The last time, it was also you.

contacts.name: Ash-Captain Tyre
contacts.greeting: Our hulls get stronger as they break. Do yours?
contacts.offer: Intruders in the deep zone. Send them to the heat death early.
contacts.trusted: When you die, we will hold your office for you.

contacts.name: Reliquarian Sabine
contacts.greeting: We sell what is left over.
contacts.offer: Bring us Abyssal Alloy from the wrecks below. We will pay in relics.
contacts.trusted: Keep this relic. It belonged to someone who looked like you.

contacts.name: Vigil-Keeper
contacts.greeting: The star is dead. We watch it anyway.
contacts.offer: A procession ship stopped answering. It may be done. Check.
contacts.trusted: Stay a while. It's quieter in a dead system.

contacts.name: Admiral Constance Reyes, Hegemony Command
contacts.greeting: State your hull and your business. Quickly.
contacts.offer: We sent a warning, years ago, to anyone listening. You were listening. Come to Command.
contacts.trusted: The bomb was learning. We thought from us. It was learning from you.

contacts.name: Captain Idris Vale
contacts.greeting: You'll fly in formation or you'll fly alone.
contacts.offer: There's a battle group on our border that needs to stop existing.
contacts.trusted: You fly like one of ours. Don't tell anyone I said that.

contacts.name: Quartermaster Ottilie Raines
contacts.greeting: Every convoy I send out, I count back in.
contacts.offer: Escort's thin this run. Pay isn't.
contacts.trusted: I keep a list of who I trust. You're on it. In pencil.

contacts.name: Archivist Benedek Sorn
contacts.greeting: The unification wars are a forbidden topic. I have the files.
contacts.offer: Some records shouldn't exist. I'd like them back anyway.
contacts.trusted: You never asked what was in the boxes. Good. Neither did I.

contacts.name: Garrison Sergeant Pell
contacts.greeting: Papers. Kidding. Nobody has papers any more.
contacts.offer: Patrol's overdue. Go look, and come back.
contacts.trusted: You came back. People don't, out here.
